name: ALCHEMISTRY
blurb: CHEMISTRY AN' TRANSMUTATION RESEARCH, INCLUDIN' DA PREPARATIONS DAT FAILED!

chem_chiral.name: CHIRAL CATALYSIS
chem_chiral.desc: A CHIRAL DIPHOSPHINE SUCH AS BINAP, CHELATED TA RUTHENIUM OR RHODIUM, MAKES DA TWO PROCHIRAL FACES OF A SUBSTRATE INEQUIVALENT IN DA TRANSITION STATE, SO HYDROGENATION OR OXIDATION PROCEEDS THROUGH DA LOWER BARRIER AN' DELIVERS ONE ENANTIOMER AT 95 TA 99 PERCENT EXCESS WIT TURNOVER NUMBERS IN DA THOUSANDS. DA INDUSTRIAL CASE IZ MENTHOL AT TEN THOUSAND TONNES A YEAR. SINCE DA MIRROR IMAGE OF A DRUG CAN BE INERT, ANTAGONISTIC OR TERATOGENIC, ENANTIOMERIC EXCESS PASSES FROM A LABORATORY STATISTIC TA A RELEASE SPECIFICATION!

chem_click.name: CLICK CHEMISTRY
chem_click.desc: COPPER(ME) CATALYSIS OF DA HUISGEN CYCLOADDITION JOINS AN ORGANIC AZIDE TA A TERMINAL ALKYNE AN' GIVES DA 1,4-TRIAZOLE ALONE, AT RATES SEVEN ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE ABOVE DA THERMAL REACTION. DA CONDITIONS IZ WATER AT ROOM TEMPERATURE, YIELDS IZ NEAR QUANTITATIVE, DA ONLY BY-PRODUCT IZ NOTHIN', AN' ALCOHOLS, AMINES, THIOLS AN' FREE CARBOXYLATES IZ LEFT UNTOUCHED. BECAUSE NEITHER PARTNER OCCURS IN A CELL, DA PAIR CAN BE REACTED INSIDE A LIVIN' ORGANISM; DA STRAINED-CYCLOOCTYNE VARIANT DROPS DA COPPER AN' WIT IT DA CYTOTOXICITY!

chem_ubiquitin.name: UBIQUITIN AN' CONTROLLED DEATH
chem_ubiquitin.desc: AN E1 ACTIVATIN' ENZYME CHARGES UBIQUITIN, A 76-RESIDUE PROTEIN, AT DA COST OF ONE ATP; AN E2 CARRIER ACCEPTS IT, AN' ONE OF SOME SIX HUNDRED E3 LIGASES DECIDES WHICH SUBSTRATE LYSINE RECEIVES IT. FOUR OR MORE UNITS LINKED THROUGH LYSINE 48 CONSTITUTE DA DEGRADATION SIGNAL. DA 26S PROTEASOME BINDS DA CHAIN, RECYCLES IT, UNFOLDS DA SUBSTRATE WIT AN ATPASE RING AN' FEEDS DA CHAIN INTO A BARREL WHOSE THREONINE PROTEASES CUT IT TA PEPTIDES OF SEVEN TA NINE RESIDUES. FOR MOST REGULATORY PROTEINS DA STEADY-STATE LEVEL IZ SET BY DIS RATE AN' NOT BY TRANSCRIPTION!

chem_metathesis.name: OLEFIN METATHESIS
chem_metathesis.desc: A RUTHENIUM ALKYLIDENE CARRYIN' AN N-HETEROCYCLIC CARBENE ADDS ACROSS A CARBON-CARBON DOUBLE BOND TA A METALLACYCLOBUTANE, WHICH RETRO-CLEAVES ALONG DA OTHER DIAGONAL AN' EXCHANGES DA ALKYLIDENE FRAGMENTS. DA CATALYST TOLERATES AIR, WATER, ESTERS, AMIDES AN' FREE ALCOHOLS, WHICH DA EARLIER MOLYBDENUM SYSTEMS DID NOT. RING-CLOSIN' METATHESIS CONVERTS A DIENE INTO A MACROCYCLE OF ANY SIZE IN ONE STEP, RELEASIN' ETHYLENE, AN' DA REACTION RUNS IN DILUTE SOLUTION TA KEEP DA INTRAMOLECULAR PATH AHEAD OF OLIGOMERISATION!

chem_gfp.name: GREEN FLUORESCENT PROTEIN
chem_gfp.desc: DA PROTEIN FROM AEQUOREA VICTORIA FOLDS INTO AN ELEVEN-STRAND BETA BARREL WIT A CENTRAL HELIX, AN' RESIDUES 65 TA 67 OF DAT HELIX CYCLISE, DEHYDRATE AN' OXIDISE ON DEY OWN INTO A P-HYDROXYBENZYLIDENE-IMIDAZOLINONE CHROMOPHORE. MOLECULAR OXYGEN IZ DA ONLY COFACTOR REQUIRED, SO DA GENE IZ SUFFICIENT. FUSED IN FRAME TA ANY CODIN' SEQUENCE IT REPORTS EXPRESSION LEVEL AN' SUBCELLULAR LOCATION AS EMISSION AT 509 NANOMETRES; DA MUTANT SERIES DAT FOLLOWS SHIFTS DA EMISSION FROM 442 TA 610 NANOMETRES AN' PERMITS TWO OR THREE PROTEINS TA BE WATCHED AT ONCE IN ONE LIVE CELL!

chem_oganesson.name: SYNTHESIS OF OGANESSON
chem_oganesson.desc: A CALCIUM-48 BEAM OF ABOUT SIX TRILLION IONS PER SECOND IZ DRIVEN INTO A CALIFORNIUM-249 TARGET FOR SOME 1,080 HOURS. THREE ATOMS OF ELEMENT 118 IZ FORMED BY HOT FUSION AT A CROSS SECTION NEAR HALF A PICOBARN AN' IDENTIFIED IN A GAS-FILLED SEPARATOR FROM DA CORRELATED ALPHA CHAIN DAT FOLLOWS WITHIN MILLISECONDS, ENDIN' IN SPONTANEOUS FISSION. NOTHIN' IZ WEIGHED AN' NOTHIN' IZ REACTED: DA CHEMISTRY OF DA ELEMENT IZ EXTRAPOLATED FROM RELATIVISTIC CALCULATIONS, WHICH PREDICT DAT DA CLOSED SHELL IZ DESTABILISED ENOUGH FOR IT TA BE A SOLID RATHER DEN A NOBLE GAS!

chem_ribosome.name: RIBOSOME STRUCTURE MAPPED
chem_ribosome.desc: CRYSTALS OF DA 50S SUBUNIT FROM HALOARCULA MARISMORTUI AN' OF DA 30S FROM THERMUS THERMOPHILUS DIFFRACT TA 2.4 AN' 3.0 ANGSTROMS, PHASED WIT OSMIUM AN' IRIDIUM CLUSTERS, AN' PLACE EVERY NUCLEOTIDE OF A 2.5 MEGADALTON ASSEMBLY. DA PEPTIDYL TRANSFERASE CENTRE CONTAINS NO PROTEIN SIDE CHAIN WITHIN EIGHTEEN ANGSTROMS OF DA REACTION, SO DA PEPTIDE BOND IZ MADE BY RIBOSOMAL RNA. DA A, P AN' E TRNA SITES IZ RESOLVED ALONG WIT DA DECODIN' CENTRE, AN' EACH ANTIBIOTIC CLASS IZ LOCATED IN DA POCKET IT OCCUPIES!

chem_crosscoupling.name: PALLADIUM CROSS-COUPLIN'
chem_crosscoupling.desc: A PALLADIUM(0) CENTRE INSERTS OXIDATIVELY INTO DA CARBON-HALOGEN BOND OF AN ARYL HALIDE; TRANSMETALATION DELIVERS DA SECOND FRAGMENT FROM A BORONIC ACID, AN ORGANOZINC OR AN ORGANOSTANNANE, AN' REDUCTIVE ELIMINATION FORMS DA NEW CARBON-CARBON BOND AN' REGENERATES DA PALLADIUM(0). BULKY ELECTRON-RICH PHOSPHINES MAKE DA TWO SLOW STEPS FAST ENOUGH FOR ARYL CHLORIDES AN' FOR CATALYST LOADINGS BELOW A TENTH OF A PERCENT. DA BORONIC ACID ROUTE USES REAGENTS DAT IZ AIR-STABLE AN' NON-TOXIC, WHICH IZ WHY IT DOMINATES PROCESS CHEMISTRY!

chem_quasicrystal.name: QUASICRYSTALS
chem_quasicrystal.desc: AN ALUMINIUM-MANGANESE MELT QUENCHED AT A MILLION KELVIN PER SECOND GIVES AN ELECTRON DIFFRACTION PATTERN OF SHARP SPOTS WIT ICOSAHEDRAL POINT SYMMETRY, INCLUDIN' FIVE-FOLD AXES DAT NO PERIODIC LATTICE CAN CARRY. DA SOLID HAB LONG-RANGE ORIENTATIONAL ORDER WITHOUT TRANSLATIONAL PERIODICITY: INDEXIN' TAKES SIX BASIS VECTORS INSTEAD OF THREE, AN' DA STRUCTURE IZ A THREE-DIMENSIONAL ANALOGUE OF A PENROSE TILIN'. STABLE, MILLIMETRE-SIZED SINGLE GRAINS OF ALUMINIUM-COPPER-IRON SETTLE DA CASE, AN' A NATURAL SPECIMEN IZ LATER RECOVERED FROM DA KHATYRKA METEORITE!

chem_gpcr.name: G-PROTEIN-COUPLED RECEPTORS
chem_gpcr.desc: DA BETA-2 ADRENERGIC RECEPTOR IZ CRYSTALLISED BOUND TA AN AGONIST AN' TA A NUCLEOTIDE-FREE HETEROTRIMERIC G PROTEIN, A COMPLEX OF SOME 150 KILODALTONS HELD TOGETHER ONLY WHILE DA NUCLEOTIDE IZ ABSENT. DA STRUCTURE RESOLVES AT 3.2 ANGSTROMS AN' SHOWS TRANSMEMBRANE HELIX SIX SWUNG FOURTEEN ANGSTROMS OUTWARD, OPENIN' DA INTRACELLULAR CAVITY DAT RECEIVES DA G PROTEIN ALPHA SUBUNIT AN' PRISIN' APART DA HELICES DAT HOLD GDP. ROUGHLY A THIRD OF MARKETED DRUGS ACT ON DIS RECEPTOR FAMILY, WHOSE ACTIVATION STEP IZ HERE CAUGHT BETWEEN STATES!

chem_water_memory.name: DA MEMORY OF WATER
chem_water_memory.desc: DA PREPARATION IZ DILUTED A HUNDREDFOLD AN' SHAKEN VIOLENTLY AT EACH STEP, THIRTY TIMES OVER, WHICH IZ A DILUTION FACTOR OF TEN TA DA SIXTIETH: PAST DA TWELFTH STEP DA EXPECTED NUMBER OF SOLUTE MOLECULES IN DA VIAL IZ BELOW ONE, AN' AVOGADRO'S NUMBER PUTS DA LAST OF DEM AT STEP TWELVE. DA PROPOSED CARRIER IZ A PERSISTENT STRUCTURE IN DA HYDROGEN-BOND NETWORK, WHICH FEMTOSECOND INFRARED SPECTROSCOPY MEASURES REARRANGIN' ON A TIMESCALE OF ONE TA TWO PICOSECONDS. BLINDED REPLICATIONS, INCLUDIN' ONE RUN UNDER A TELEVISED PROTOCOL WIT A PRIZE ATTACHED, RETURN DA ACTIVITY OF DA SOLVENT!

chem_water_fuel.name: DA WATER-FUELLED CAR
chem_water_fuel.desc: AN ONBOARD CELL ELECTROLYSES WATER, DA HYDROGEN IZ FED TA A MODIFIED INTAKE, AN' COMBUSTION RETURNS DA WATER TA DA TANK. DISSOCIATION OF ONE MOLE OF LIQUID WATER COSTS 286 KILOJOULES AN' ITS COMBUSTION RETURNS AT MOST DA SAME 286, BEFORE AN ELECTROLYSER OVERPOTENTIAL OF SOME 20 PERCENT, AN ALTERNATOR EFFICIENCY OF 50 PERCENT AN' A THERMAL EFFICIENCY NEAR 30 PERCENT IZ TAKEN OUT. DA CYCLE CLOSES AT A LOSS OF ROUGHLY SIX UNITS IN EVERY SEVEN, AN' DA DEMONSTRATIONS DAT CIRCULATE IZ RUNNIN' ON DA BATTERY, A HIDDEN FUEL LINE, OR BOTH!

chem_alkaline_diet.name: DA ALKALINE BODY
chem_alkaline_diet.desc: FOODS IZ RANKED BY DA POTENTIAL RENAL ACID LOAD OF DEY COMBUSTION ASH AN' SELECTED TA DRIVE SERUM TOWARD DA ALKALINE. ARTERIAL PH IZ REGULATED BETWEEN 7.35 AN' 7.45 BY DA BICARBONATE BUFFER, BY RESPIRATORY CLEARANCE OF CARBON DIOXIDE WITHIN MINUTES AN' BY RENAL PROTON EXCRETION WITHIN HOURS; A SERUM PH OUTSIDE 6.8 TA 7.8 IZ NOT COMPATIBLE WIT LIFE, AN' NO DIET MOVES IT. WHAT DA DIET DOES MOVE IZ URINE PH, WITHIN A DAY, AN' DA TUMOUR CLAIMS ATTACHED TA IT IZ A CATEGORY ERROR, SINCE DA EXTRACELLULAR ACIDITY OF A TUMOUR IZ A PRODUCT OF ITS METABOLISM!

chem_target_fabrication.name: ACTINIDE TARGET FABRICATION
chem_target_fabrication.desc: MILLIGRAM QUANTITIES OF AN ACTINIDE DAT DOES NOT OCCUR IN NATURE IZ ELECTRODEPOSITED FROM ISOPROPANOL ONTO A TITANIUM BACKIN' FOIL TWO MICROMETRES THICK, AT A SURFACE DENSITY OF ABOUT 0.3 MILLIGRAMS PER SQUARE CENTIMETRE. DA FOIL IZ MOUNTED ON A WHEEL TURNIN' AT TWO THOUSAND REVOLUTIONS PER MINUTE SO NO POINT STAYS UNDER DA BEAM FOR MORE DEN A MILLISECOND. A FEW HUNDRED WATTS OF BEAM POWER IZ DEPOSITED IN A LAYER THINNER DEN A WAVELENGTH OF LIGHT, AN' DA TARGET MUST RUN FOR MONTHS WITHOUT BLISTERIN', SPUTTERIN' AWAY OR LOSIN' ENOUGH MATERIAL TA SPOIL DA CROSS-SECTION MEASUREMENT!

chem_synchrotron.name: SYNCHROTRON CRYSTALLOGRAPHY
chem_synchrotron.desc: ELECTRONS CIRCULATIN' AT SIX TA EIGHT GIGA-ELECTRONVOLTS IZ MADE TA OSCILLATE IN AN UNDULATOR, A PERIODIC MAGNET ARRAY IN WHICH DA EMISSION FROM EVERY POLE ADDS COHERENTLY, AN' DA RESULTIN' X-RAY BEAM IZ TEN ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE BRIGHTER DEN A ROTATIN' ANODE AN' TUNABLE ACROSS AN ABSORPTION EDGE. DAT FLUX IZ DA PRECONDITION FOR A UNIT CELL OF A HUNDRED THOUSAND ATOMS, WHOSE REFLECTIONS IZ WEAK AN' CLOSELY SPACED: DA CRYSTAL IZ HELD AT 100 KELVIN, AN' DA DATASET MUST BE COMPLETE BEFORE DA ACCUMULATED DOSE DESTROYS DA DIFFRACTION, WHICH IT DOES AT ABOUT THIRTY MEGAGRAY!

chem_heavy_atom.name: HEAVY-ATOM PHASIN'
chem_heavy_atom.desc: A DIFFRACTION EXPERIMENT RECORDS INTENSITIES AN' LOSES DA PHASE OF EVERY REFLECTION, AN' DA ELECTRON DENSITY NO CAN BE COMPUTED FROM AMPLITUDES ALONE. SOAKIN' DA CRYSTAL IN MERCURY, PLATINUM OR A LANTHANIDE, OR GROWIN' IT FROM SELENOMETHIONINE-SUBSTITUTED PROTEIN, INTRODUCES SCATTERERS WHOSE POSITIONS IZ FOUND FROM DIFFERENCE PATTERSON MAPS; MEASURIN' EITHER SIDE OF DEY ABSORPTION EDGE SEPARATES DA ANOMALOUS AN' DISPERSIVE DIFFERENCES, AN' EACH DERIVATIVE NARROWS DA PHASE PROBABILITY UNTIL DA DENSITY CAN BE TRACED. NON-ISOMORPHISM BETWEEN DERIVATIVE AN' NATIVE IZ DA USUAL REASON A DATASET IZ ABANDONED!

chem_membrane_protein.name: MEMBRANE PROTEIN STABILIZATION
chem_membrane_protein.desc: REMOVED FROM DA BILAYER INTO DETERGENT, A SEVEN-TRANSMEMBRANE RECEPTOR LOSES ACTIVITY WITHIN HOURS AN' NEVER NUCLEATES A LATTICE. FOUR MEASURES HOLD IT: EIGHT TA TEN THERMOSTABILISIN' POINT MUTATIONS FOUND BY ALANINE SCANNIN', WHICH RAISE DA MELTIN' POINT BY TWENTY DEGREES; T4 LYSOZYME OR BRIL FUSED INTO DA FLEXIBLE THIRD INTRACELLULAR LOOP TA SUPPLY A POLAR CRYSTAL CONTACT; A HIGH-AFFINITY LIGAND BOUND THROUGHOUT PURIFICATION; AN' CRYSTALLISATION IN A LIPIDIC CUBIC PHASE OF MONOOLEIN, IN WHICH DA PROTEIN STAYS IN A CURVED BILAYER WHILE NUCLEATIN' FROM DA LIPID MESH!
